CITY OF SAN MARINO

  CITY COUNCIL AGENDA

Steven W. Huang, DDS, Mayor  www.SanMarinoCA.gov
Gretchen Shepherd Romey, Vice Mayor  (626) 300-0700 Phone

Tony Chou, Council Member  City Hall Council Chamber

Calvin Lo, Council Member  2200 Huntington Drive
Steve Talt, Council Member  San Marino, CA 91108

Philippe Eskandar, City Manager

  ADJOURNED REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  SAN MARINO CITY COUNCIL
  FRIDAY, OCTOBER 25, 2024 AT 8:30 AM
  CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  2200 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Council
with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 2nd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m. Typically,
adjourned meetings are held on the last Friday of every month at 8:30 a.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting
should contact the City Clerk via email at CityClerk@SanMarinoCA.gov or by phone at (626)
300-0705 prior to the meeting for assistance.

The public is welcome to attend the meeting in person or remotely via Zoom, however, the
meeting will proceed as normal even if there are technical difficulties with Zoom. The City
will do it’s best to resolve any technical issues as quickly as possible.

How to view or listen to the meeting from home:
  Visit www.SanMarinoCA.gov/Zoom

How to offer public comment from home:

  Public comment will be accepted by email to CityClerk@SanMarinoCA.gov until 3:00
  p.m. the day before the meeting. Written public comment received by 3:00 p.m. will
  be distributed to City Council during the meeting. Any comments received after 3:00

AGENDA – OCTOBER 25, 2024  PAGE 1 of 5
   p.m. will be included in the public comment record but not provided to City Council
  at the meeting.
  Written public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us
  teleconference module during the meeting. Written Zoom comments will be accepted
  after the in-person comments.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Council Member Chou, Council Member Lo, Council Member Talt, Vice Mayor Shepherd
Romey, and Mayor Huang

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the
Stoneman Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.SanMarinoCA.gov.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the City Council by
completing a public comment card and giving it to the City Clerk prior to the meeting. At
this time, the public may address the City Council on items that are not on the agenda.
Pursuant to state law, the City Council may not discuss or take action on issues not on the
meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2). The Mayor reserves the right to
place limits on duration of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such items.

  PRESENTATION

 SAN GABRIEL VALLEY COUNCIL OF GOVERNMENTS 2024 UPDATE

  NEW BUSINESS

 1.  APPROVAL OF LENSLOCK BODY-WORN AND VEHICLE MOUNTED
  CAMERAS FOR THE POLICE DEPARTMENT

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council authorize the City Manager to
  execute a contract with LensLock, Inc. for body-worn cameras and in-car cameras, in
  the amount not to exceed $294,337.10 for the term ending October 31, 2029. If the
  City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

AGENDA – OCTOBER 25, 2024  PAGE 2 of 5
   “I move to authorize the City Manager to execute a contract with LensLock, Inc. for
  body-worn and in-car cameras, in the amount not to exceed $294,337.10 for the
  term ending October 31, 2029, and approve a COPS Fund FY 24/25 budget
  appropriation of $1,749.81.”

 2.  ACCEPT DONATION FROM ROTARY CLUB OF SAN MARINO IN THE
  AMOUNT OF $75,000 FOR THE LACY PARK PLAYGROUND
  REPLACEMENT PROJECT AND INCREASE THE BUDGET FOR THE FIRST
  PHASE OF THE PROJECT TO $325,000, AUTHORIZE THE PARKS AND
  PUBLIC WORKS DIRECTOR/CITY ENGINEER TO FINALIZE THE
  DESIGN TO PROCURE AND INSTALL THE FIRST PHASE OF THE LACY
  PARK PLAYGROUND REPLACEMENT PROJECT AND AUTHORIZE THE
  CITY MANAGER TO EXECUTE THE AGREEMENT WITH THE SELECTED
  VENDOR IN AN AMOUNT NOT TO EXCEED $325,000

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council 1) accept a donation from the
  Rotary Club of San Marino in the amount of $75,000 for the Lacy Park Playground
  Replacement Project and increase the budget for the first phase of the project to
  $325,000, 2) authorize the Parks and& Public Works Director/City Engineer to finalize
  the design to procure and install the first phase of the playground replacement as
  described in the staff report, and 3) authorize the City Manager to execute the
  agreement with the selected vendor in an amount not to exceed $325,000.

  “I move to 1) accept a donation from the Rotary Club of San Marino in the amount of
  $75,000 for the Lacy Park Playground Replacement Project and increase the budget
  for the first phase of the project to $325,000, 2) authorize the Parks and& Public
  Works Director/City Engineer to finalize the design to procure and install the first
  phase of the playground replacement, and 3) authorize the City Manager to execute
  the agreement with the selected vendor in an amount not to exceed $325,000.”

  CONSENT CALENDAR

 3.  AWARD OF A CONSTRUCTION AGREEMENT TO G2 CONSTRUCTION,
  INC. FOR THE PURCHASE AND INSTALLATION OF CATCH BASIN
  TRASH AND DEBRIS CAPTURE DEVICES IN THE AMOUNT OF
  $100,000

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council approve the procurement and
  installation of trash and debris capture devices from G2 Construction, Inc. in the
  amount of $100,000.

  “I move to approve the Construction Agreement for the procurement and installation
  of trash and debris capture devices from G2 Construction, Inc. in the amount of
  $100,000.”

AGENDA – OCTOBER 25, 2024  PAGE 3 of 5
  4.  APPROVAL OF NOTICE OF COMPLETION FOR YEAR 3 OF THE ANNUAL
  SIDEWALK REPLACEMENT PROGRAM

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council accept Year 3 of the Multi-
  Year Sidewalk Replacement Program as complete and authorize the City Clerk to file
  the Notice of Completion. If the City Council concurs, an appropriate motion would
  be:

  “I move to accept Year 3 of the Multi-Year Sidewalk Replacement Program Project
  No. 23-9272 performed by CJ Concrete Construction, Inc., as complete, and
  authorize the City Clerk to file the Notice of Completion.”

 5.  APPROVAL OF FY 2023-2024 BUDGET CARRYOVERS AND FY 2024-
  2025 RE-BUDGETS AND FINAL FY 2023-2024 BUDGET ADJUSTMENTS

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council approve the requested FY 2023-
  2024 carryovers, updates to the FY 2024-2025 re-budgets, and the budget
  amendments to the funds and accounts as noted in the attachments. If the City
  Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to approve the requested FY 2023-2024 carryovers, updates to the FY 2024-
  2025 re-budgets, and the budget amendments to the funds and accounts as noted in
  the attachments of the Staff Report.”

 6.  RECEIVE AND FILE FINANCIAL REPORT FOR 2ND HALF OF FISCAL
  YEAR 2023-24 (JANUARY 2024 TO JUNE 2024)

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that Council receive and file this report. If the
  City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to receive and file the financial report reflecting the City’s revenues and
  expenditures as of June 30, 2024.”

 7.  COMMITMENT OF DONATIONS FUND YEAR-END BALANCE RESERVES

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve the accompanying
  resolution to commit the balance as of June 30, 2024, as noted in the attachments. If
  the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would
  be:

  “I move to adopt Resolution No. R-24-28 to commit the balance of $321,603 in the
  Donations Fund as of June 30, 2024.”

 8.  ADOPTION OF SIDE LETTER OF AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE SAN
  MARINO POLICE OFFICERS ASSOCIATION AND THE CITY OF SAN
  MARINO CONCERNING THE PROPOSED MODIFICATION TO SECTION
  06.01 AND ADDITION OF SECTION 06.03 TO THE MEMORANDUM OF
  UNDERSTANDING

AGENDA – OCTOBER 25, 2024  PAGE 4 of 5
   Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council adopt the Side Letter of
  Agreement between the San Marino Police Officers Association and the City of San
  Marino. If the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate
  motion would be:

  “I move to adopt the Side Letter of Agreement between the San Marino Police
  Officers Association and the City of San Marino concerning the proposed modification
  to Section 06.01 and addition of Section 06.03 to the Memorandum of
  Understanding.”

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTION

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City
received by members of the City Council. All public writings distributed by the City of San
Marino to at least a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda will be
made available at the Public Counter at City Hall located at 2200 Huntington Drive, San
Marino, California 91108, and will also be included in the public agenda packet that will
available for review at the City Council meeting.
